title: Zolakwika zakunja
description: Macheza awa afika pachimake chokumbukira AI, ngati bolodi yoyera ikudzaza. Titha kukulitsa zenera la kukumbukira (lotchedwa kukula kwa nkhani) kuti likumbukire zambiri, koma litha kugwiritsa ntchito kukumbukira kwambiri pakompyuta yanu. Tithanso kuchepetsa zolowetsa, zomwe zikutanthauza kuti iiwala mbiri yakale yochezera kuti tipeze mwayi wolandila mauthenga atsopano.
increaseContextSizeDescription: Kodi mukufuna kuwonjezera kukula kwa nkhaniyo?
contextOverflowDetail: Pempholi linkafunika ma tokeni a {{request}}, koma zenera lachitsanzo lili ndi {{context}} yokha.
contextOverflowGeneric: Pempho limaposa kukula kwa nkhani zomwe zilipo.
emptyReply: Mtunduwu udatha popanda kuyankha. Yesani kupanganso, kapena yang'anani zokonda za opereka.

engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Zomangamanga zamtunduwu sizimathandizidwa ndi injini yomwe ilipo. Kusintha injini kuchokera ku Zikhazikiko kungawonjezere chithandizo.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Mtunduwu udatenga nthawi yayitali kuti ulowetse ndipo udaimitsidwa. Kachilombo kakang'ono kapena kakulidwe kakang'ono ka nkhani nthawi zambiri kumathandiza.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Laibulale yomwe injini imafunikira ikusowa, chifukwa chake siyingayambike.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Dalaivala wanu wa GPU ndiwokalamba kwambiri kuti musagwiritse ntchito injiniyi. Kusintha dalaivala, kapena kusinthira ku injini ya CPU mu Zochunira, kukonza izi.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Palibe kukumbukira kokwanira kuyendetsa mtundu uwu. Choyimira chaching'ono kapena kukula kwachinthu chocheperako nthawi zambiri kumathandiza.
engine.IO_ERROR: Fayilo sinathe kuwerengedwa kapena kulembedwa poyambitsa mtunduwo.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: China chake sichinayende bwino mkati mwa Novera poyambitsa mtunduwo.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Injini ya llama.cpp ikugwira ntchito, koma Novera siingathe kulumikizidwa nayo pakompyutayi (127.0.0.1). Pulogalamu ya VPN, proxy kapena chitetezo mwina ikulepheretsa kulumikizana kwanuko.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: Injini ya llama.cpp inayima mosayembekezereka. Kutumiza uthengawo kumayambiranso; ikamayima, mapulogalamu achitetezo kapena oyendetsa GPU angakhale omwe achititsa.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Mitundu ya m'dera lanu sikugwira ntchito pa purosesa ya kompyutayi. Injini ya Novera ya m'deralo imapangidwira Apple Silicon Macs (M1 kapena yatsopano), kotero singayambire pa Intel Mac. Opereka mtambo ndi mwambo akugwirabe ntchito.
